newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Oil's second hydrocracker seen on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Thai Oil's second hydrocracker seen on schedule.

text.p: Thai Oil Co Ltd said on Thursday that its second hydrocracker unit designed to increase diesel output would start up by end-February as scheduled.
The 27,000 barrels per day unit is expected to reach full capacity by March or April, a company spokeswoman said.
"At this point, we believe everything will move on schedule," she told Reuters.
The 5.4 billion baht ($207 million) unit will raise the production of gas oil to 55 percent of Thai Oil's total capacity of 220,000 bpd from the current 50 percent.
A source said earlier that the new hydrocracker was expected to enhance its refinery margin by US$0.74 per barrel from an average of $4.48 per barrel in 1995/96 (October-September).
The firm's products are sold mostly in the domestic market.
